dataSourceSummary.interpretationNote: The CSV identifies where to inspect; it does not prove the exact clicked element.

pagesInspected.finding: The standalone audio page had playback/copy states, but WAV export did not expose a busy, success, or error message and did not guard duplicate export clicks while rendering.
The home tool is a high-traffic interactive translator with sample, copy, play, and tool-navigation controls. No dead-click or error evidence was present in the export.
The practice page uses repeated check, skip, next, retry, and share interactions with visible correctness feedback.
The sound generator already exposes export working/success/error status for WAV and MP3 and disables export when invalid.
Sentence practice gives check/next/skip feedback and round completion states; repeated clicks are expected drill behavior.
The MP3 generator already shows MP3/WAV working/success/error status and keeps preview/export controls visible.
The decoder uses processing state, disabled decode behavior during analysis, file validation messages, and visible output/error panels.
Audio practice is an intentional repeated-listen and answer flow. No local evidence supported a broad UI change.
Typing practice is an intentional rapid-input route with session state, pause/resume/reset behavior, and a completion dialog.
The route places the encoder workspace above support sections and includes contextual links into decoder, chart, word separator, audio, and practice paths.
The route places the decoder workspace above support sections and includes contextual links into reader, audio decoder, dictionary, and spacing tools.

pagesInspected.classification: needs owner/session-replay review before more changes
pagesInspected.finding: The route already has a Start quiz link, clear Flash prompt button, flashing safety messaging, answer/check/skip/next states, and result actions. The 23-visitor 100% bounce sample is too small to justify a redesign without session-level evidence.

pagesInspected.classification: high-bounce reference routes intentionally left unchanged
pagesInspected.finding: These are narrow-answer or reference routes where bounce can be normal. Existing pages include direct explanatory content and related next-step links; no confirmed broken or unclear click target was found during code inspection.

confirmedUxIssues.issue: WAV export could feel unresponsive because the top-level audio page did not announce export progress, success, or failure.
confirmedUxIssues.fix: Added WAV export working, success, and error status; disabled duplicate export while rendering; changed the export labels to Preparing WAV during work.

fixesMade: Added visible /audio WAV export feedback: Preparing WAV file..., WAV download started., and clean failure messages.
Prevented duplicate /audio WAV export clicks while a render is already in progress.
Added a Playwright regression that waits for /audio hydration, exports a short WAV, verifies completion feedback, and verifies a real audio/wav blob was created.
pagesIntentionallyLeftUnchanged: Home, practice, sound generator, sentence practice, MP3 generator, audio decoder, audio practice, typing, encoder, decoder, visual quiz, and reference pages without a confirmed UX blocker.
analyticsInstrumentationGaps: The provided export aggregates by URL only. It does not identify the clicked element, rage-click cluster, device class, or session replay context.
No targeted PostHog event changes were added because this branch did not find an existing local analytics wrapper appropriate for narrow event naming.
recommendedNextStep: Merge behavior-friction branch to main, then rerun production deploy/final sanity only after Netlify is serving the latest main.
